summary: The team wants the build workflow's pull requests to be opened as drafts with a clearer title format, so reviewers can tell automated PRs apart.
Requested by the team lead; internal documentation work, no customer involvement.

acceptance_criteria: The build workflow (.github/workflows/agent-build.yml) opens its pull request as a draft.
The pull request title uses the format [TICKET-KEY] <summary>.
Existing tests for the build workflow are updated to cover the new title format.
out_of_scope: Changes to the work order or implementation plan workflows.

codebase.relevance: The build workflow that opens pull requests.

getting_started: Read the files listed under the codebase section first.
